credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe standing by the river in the shade holding her black brimmed hat in a skirt and sleeveless strapped blouse. This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe with Hat in Hand
